children: US-based Mastercard Incorporated-owned Mastercard Asia/Pacific Pte, has exited Pine Labs, the merchant commerce platform, by selling its entire 4.31 percent stake through open market transactions on September 22.
Pine Labs shares rallied 2 percent to Rs 197.58 amid high volumes, extending their gains for the third consecutive session.
According to block deal data published by the BSE, Mastercard sold 4.97 crore equity shares, representing 4.31 percent of Pine Labs' paid-up equity, for Rs 933.57 crore.
The shares were sold to 13 domestic and global institutional investors at Rs 187.75 apiece.
ICICI Prudential Life Insurance Company emerged as the largest buyer, acquiring 93.1 lakh shares, representing 0.8 percent of paid-up equity, for Rs 174.79 crore.
Societe Generale picked up 87.7 lakh shares, or 0.76 percent stake, for Rs 164.65 crore, while Citigroup Global Markets Singapore bought 66.7 lakh shares, or 0.57 percent stake, for Rs 125.22 crore.

Ghisallo Master Fund, BNP Paribas Arbitrage, NRSGVCC, Goldman Sachs Bank Europe, Susquehanna Pacific, Kotak Mahindra AMC, Morgan Stanley Asia Singapore, Edelweiss MF, RAMS Equities Portfolio Fund and Franklin Templeton MF were among the other investors. Together, they picked up the remaining 2.49 crore equity shares for Rs 468.89 crore.

title: Mastercard exits Pine Labs, sells entire 4.31% stake for Rs 933.57 crore
